attacks: Ram attack points:20 attack energy:G attack description:

name: Shiinotic
attacks: Flickering Spores attack points:50 attack energy:GG attack description: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
card_description: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Dhelmise
attacks: Energy Whip attack points:20+ attack energy:G attack description: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra [G] Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.
card_description: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Ponyta
attacks: Stomp attack points:10+ attack energy:R attack description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
card_description: It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
attacks: Rising Lunge attack points:40+ attack energy:RC attack description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.
card_description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Magmar
attacks: Fire Blast attack points:80 attack energy:RR attack description: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon.
card_description: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Larvesta
attacks: Combustion attack points:30 attack energy:RC attack description:
card_description: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

name: Volcarona
attacks: Volcanic Ash attack points: attack energy:RRC attack description: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
card_description: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Salandit
attacks: Venoshock attack points:10+ attack energy:C attack description: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.
card_description: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
attacks: Poison Claws attack points:30 attack energy:R attack description: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
card_description: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Magikarp
attacks: Leap Out attack points: attack energy:W attack description: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
card_description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados ex
attacks: Rampaging Whirlpool attack points:140 attack energy:WWWC attack description: Discard a random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

name: Vaporeon

name: Finneon
attacks: Water Gun attack points:20 attack energy:W attack description:
card_description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon
attacks: Aqua Liner attack points: attack energy:WW attack description: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
card_description: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

name: Chewtle
attacks: Bite attack points:30 attack energy:WC attack description:
card_description: Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another Chewtle’s horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle.

name: Drednaw
attacks: Crunch attack points:70 attack energy:WWW attack description: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
card_description: Its massive, jagged teeth can crush a boulder in a single bite. This Pokémon has an extremely vicious disposition.

name: Cramorant
attacks: Dive attack points:60 attack energy:WWC attack description: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
card_description: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

name: Pikachu
attacks: Circle Circuit attack points:10x attack energy:L attack description: This attack does 10 damage for each of your Benched [L] Pokémon.
card_description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu
attacks: Gigashock attack points:60 attack energy:LLL attack description: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
card_description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Electabuzz
attacks: Thunder Spear attack points: attack energy:LL attack description: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
card_description: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Joltik
attacks: Bug Bite attack points:30 attack energy:L attack description:
card_description: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
attacks: Electroweb attack points:70 attack energy:LL attack description: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
card_description: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Dedenne
attacks: Thunder Shock attack points:10 attack energy:L attack description: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
card_description: It’s small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people’s homes and charge itself.

name: Mew
attacks: Psy Report attack points:20 attack energy:P attack description: Your opponent reveals their hand.
card_description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Elgyem
attacks: Headbutt attack points:20 attack energy:P attack description:

name: Beheeyem
attacks: Mind Jack attack points:10+ attack energy:P attack description: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Flabébé
attacks: Hypnotic Gaze attack points: attack energy:P attack description: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Floette
attacks: Leaf Drain attack points:40 attack energy:P attack description: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Florges
attacks: Bloomshine attack points:80 attack energy:PP attack description: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.
card_description: This Pokémon creates an impressive flower garden in its territory. It draws forth the power of the red flowers around its neck.

name: Swirlix
attacks: Fairy Wind attack points:20 attack energy:P attack description:

name: Slurpuff
attacks: Magical Shot attack points:60 attack energy:PC attack description:

name: Mankey
attacks: Focus Fist attack points:50 attack energy:F attack description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
card_description: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
attacks: Punch attack points:50 attack energy:F attack description:

name: Geodude
attacks: Light Punch attack points:30 attack energy:FC attack description:

name: Graveler
attacks: Lunge Out attack points:40 attack energy:FC attack description:
card_description: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

attacks: Guard Press attack points:120 attack energy:FFFC attack description: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

name: Stonjourner

name: Koffing
attacks: Division attack points: attack energy:D attack description: Put 1 random Koffing from your deck onto your Bench.

name: Purrloin
attacks: Scratch attack points:20 attack energy:D attack description:

name: Liepard
attacks: Slash attack points:40 attack energy:D attack description:

name: Venipede
attacks: Ram attack points:20 attack energy:D attack description:

name: Whirlipede
attacks: Poison Sting attack points:20 attack energy:D attack description: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks: Venoshock attack points:70+ attack energy:DC attack description: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Druddigon
attacks: Dragon Claw attack points:90 attack energy:RWC attack description:
card_description: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.

name: Pidgey
attacks: Flap attack points:20 attack energy:C attack description:
